## Common WHERE Filters

```sql
-- 按分区过滤（所有查询必带）
WHERE grass_region = upper('${grass_region}')
  AND grass_date = date'${grass_date}'

-- 按 type 过滤
AND type = 'traffic'            -- 流量效果对比
AND type = 'attribution_order'  -- 订单归因效果对比
AND type = 'attribution_addtocart_imp' -- ATC+展示归因效果对比
AND type = 'finance'            -- 扣费效果对比

-- 仅已关联的记录（dashboard 端）
AND new_join_key IS NOT NULL

-- 查找差异记录
AND *_old IS DISTINCT FROM *_new
AND model_id_old IS DISTINCT FROM model_id_new
AND location_in_ads_old IS DISTINCT FROM location_in_ads_new
AND match_type_old IS DISTINCT FROM match_type_new
AND query_old IS DISTINCT FROM query_new

-- 过滤特定情况
AND location_in_ads_old != '0'           -- 排除旧版为0的情况
AND match_type_old != '0'                -- 排除旧版为0的情况
AND cardinality(plan_bucket_list_old) > 0 -- 旧版bucket非空
AND cardinality(plan_bucket_list_old) != 0
AND cardinality(traffic_bucket_list_old) > 0

-- 特定入口
AND entrance IN (27,28,37,38,39)
AND entrance IN (38)
AND entrance = 54

-- 按小时筛选（仅写文件中有 h_new）
AND h_new = 8
AND h_new > 17
```

## Common JOIN Patterns

```sql
-- Dashboard 端：关联 entry_point 映射表获取场景名
SELECT t1.*, t3.entry_point AS scence
FROM (
  SELECT *
  FROM mp_paidads.temp_unify_output_performance_info_di
  WHERE grass_region = upper('${grass_region}')
    AND grass_date = date'${grass_date}')
    AND type = 'traffic'
    AND new_join_key IS NOT NULL
) t1
JOIN mp_paidads.dim_entry_point_mapping_v2 t3
  ON t1.entrance = t3.entrance
GROUP BY t1.entrance, t3.entry_point
```

## Common Aggregations

```sql
-- 计算字段一致率（一致记录数 / 总记录数）
SELECT
  count(*) AS total_cnt,
  sum(CASE WHEN new_join_key IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / count(*) AS join_rate,
  sum(CASE WHEN ads_id_new <=> ads_id_old THEN 0 ELSE 1 END) * 1.0 / count(*) AS ads_id_rate,
  sum(CASE WHEN item_id_new <=> item_id_old THEN 0 ELSE 1 END) * 1.0 / count(*) AS item_id_rate,
  ...
FROM mp_paidads.temp_unify_output_performance_info_di

-- 分类统计 null 比率
SELECT
  sum(CASE WHEN ls_session_id_old IS DISTINCT FROM ls_session_id_new
            AND ls_session_id_old = '0' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / count(*) AS old_null,
  sum(CASE WHEN ls_session_id_old IS DISTINCT FROM ls_session_id_new
            AND ls_session_id_new = '0' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / count(*) AS new_null,
  sum(CASE WHEN ls_session_id_old = ls_session_id_new
            THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / count(*) AS equal_ratio
FROM mp_paidads.temp_unify_output_performance_info_di

-- DISTINCT type 枚举
SELECT DISTINCT type
FROM mp_paidads.temp_unify_output_performance_info_di
```

```
      temp_unify_output_performance_attribution_di_ph

    performance_attribution_addtocart_diff/Data Processing/

    join: old JOIN new ON join_key

    performance_traffic_diff/Data Processing/
      temp_unify_output_performance_traffic_di_ph
    old: mp_paidads.dwd_advertise_performance_di__reg_s0_live (report_type IS NULL, click_timestamp IS NULL AND imp_timestamp IS NULL)
    new: paidads_mart.dwd_event_performance_hi__reg_s0_live (source_type='traffic')
    join: old LEFT JOIN new ON join_key

Insert Strategy:
  INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE temp_unify_output_performance_info_di
    PARTITION (grass_region, grass_date, type)

Downstream:
  temp_unify_output_performance_di          (dashboard aggregation, per entrance x entry_point)
  temp_unify_output_performance_join_rate_di (join rate per entrance)
```

## Derived Metrics (派生指标)

```sql
-- 字段一致率 = 不一致行数 / 总行数
ads_id_rate = sum(if(ads_id_new <=> ads_id_old, 0, 1)) * 1.0 / count(*)

-- Join 率
join_rate = sum(if(new_join_key IS NOT NULL, 1, 0)) / count(*)

-- 新旧值差异检测（考虑旧值为 NULL 或默认值的情况）
sum(if((account_id_new <=> account_id_old) OR coalesce(account_id_old, '') = '', 0, 1)) * 1.0 / count(*)

-- 数值类型差异检测（差值 < epsilon 视为一致）
sum(if(coalesce(raw_expense_new, 0.0) - coalesce(raw_expense_old, 0.0) < 0.00001, 0, 1)) * 1.0 / count(*)

-- Array 类型对比
sum(if((plan_bucket_list_new <=> plan_bucket_list_old) OR size(plan_bucket_list_old) = 0, 0, 1)) * 1.0 / count(*)
```
